title: Add purchase-quote price approval and supplier selection history
description: Add a development-only purchase-quote approval workflow that records the selected supplier, decision basis and immutable approval history before order conversion. Do not execute production SQL or deploy.
acceptance_criteria: A purchase-quote batch exposes pending, approved and rejected price decisions with actor, time and reason.
Order conversion accepts only an approved selected quote and preserves the approval reference.
History is append-only and rejects duplicate, stale or cross-batch decisions.
Release build and focused unit tests pass.

human_gate.reason: Development build gate; production migration is excluded.
